title: Zenavia
body:
# Zenavia

Zenavia gives the best experience in terms of gameplay. In Infected, no matter how you play, you can win.

## ❓ How to play

When the game begins, some players will be selected as the "Alpha Zombies". They need to kill all the humans. Players can hide, camp, run or try to fight. Your only goal is to survive, no matter what, because if you die, you turn into a zombie. The more the zombies, more the chaos.


![Picture of two zombies fighting against a human](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1238a9397feed4814e8ea0ec7f2ec40f49253e1.png)


## 🤌 Gameplay as it's finest 

The game has 40 maps, each of them brings a new way to play. You can even recognize some maps of your favorite games. To put some spicy in every games, we added scenarios. These 20 scenarios will try to change totally your way of playing the game. Your ally can betray you, a zombie can switch with your postion, the map can change mid-game, and so on...

![Map Port](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dcc3602c2b75fcad50fec1cfeb1d67f8a4746ca.jpeg)

## 🛥️ Community Driven

The community can build their own maps, they help us grow our huge map pool. In our creative mode, people visit other worlds to test all run paths, or future main spots.
